design.independence_policy: Only semantic_case_id units are independent; controlled configurations within a lineage are repeated configurations.

cases.request: Generate a free-base aerial robot named QuadScoutHoverA. A 1.8 kg box fuselage has four rotors at 0.22 m arm length, each producing thrust along body Z and a signed yaw moment. Four thrust actuators are independently commanded, with a command magnitude limit of 8.64 N-per-rotor. Take off vertically, settle at 2.5 m altitude, and hold level attitude and zero yaw. An IMU, altimeter, and 10 Hz position sensor provide feedback. Model gravity 9.81 m/s2, air density 1.225 kg/m3, and linear translational drag. Use cascaded position and attitude control with thrust allocation. Apply a controlled 2 N wind force disturbance during the middle third of the scenario. Run at 80 Hz for 8 s and retain synchronized state, command, and sensor traces. Require rotor bounds, altitude settling, roll and pitch below 0.40 rad, and positive altitude, primary tracking error below 0.203 m after 5.2 s, and no NaN or infinite physical, control, or estimator values. Treat facts not stated in this request as unknown rather than inventing them.
